shared_elements: low relief carved in pale stone
horizontal band of repeated motifs running above a main scene
row of figures in profile facing the same direction
repeated near-identical forms in a frieze-like register
justification: Both surfaces organise their imagery into stacked horizontal registers, with a band of small repeated motifs running along the top above a row of profile figures aligned in the same direction, which is a genuine compositional echo. The decisive difference is the subject and execution: A shows coarse, rounded, schematic animal forms in shallow irregular relief on a rough block, while B shows crisply modelled, densely detailed human figures with patterned garments carrying vessels across a smoothly finished wall.
